data.overview: A railway worker rescues a little girl orphaned in a train disaster and raises her beside his own son. Years later, as she grows into a young woman, he must decide whether to reveal the truth about her birth and the family he built around her.
data.tagline: A father's love, a truth delayed.
data.title: The Railwayman's Daughter
